svg.title: Exact 3D Inverse Central Projection to the R=3 Hemisphere
svg.desc: A three-dimensional projected drawing generated from the 21-square central section: every unique tangent-plane vertex is joined to the origin and mapped to the radius-three upper hemisphere by Q=3P divided by norm P.
svg.text: Figure 2. Exact 3D Inverse Central Projection to the R=3 Hemisphere
All vertices of the 21-square central section are projected from the tangent plane Z=3 onto the upper hemisphere.
tangent plane at the north pole
21 tangent squares; 32 unique vertices; every vertex ray is drawn.

g.text: Exact data map: the 21-square section from Figure 1 is placed on Z=3; every tangent-plane vertex P is joined to O.
Each line meets the R=3 hemisphere at Q. This is a state-space reading, not a physical spacetime curvature claim.
